factual_claims.claim: Fair values across the European portfolio grew by 2.9% to SEK 324,429 million, supported by rising net operating income, value-accretive capital expenditure, and favourable ownership housing market conditions in markets such as Denmark, the Netherlands, and Poland.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Investment Properties section: 'Change in fair value of investment properties, for the year were SEK 9,498 million (8,553) corresponding to 3% (2.6%) of fair value... The average valuation yield was 3.69% (3.64%).' Country Fair Value Development table shows growth in Denmark (+7.2%), Netherlands (+5.4%), Poland (+4.1%).

factual_claims.claim: Real economic occupancy stabilised at 98.5%, matching the previous year, with stronger occupancy trends emerging throughout the latter half of 2025 as newly developed units in the United Kingdom gradually reached stability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Real Economic Occupancy section: 'For the year, annual real economic occupancy remained flat at 98.5% (98.5%)... Over the course of 2025, real economic occupancy improved on a quarterly basis... the United Kingdom delivered 464 new development units, which has been gradually stabilising throughout the year with occupancy increasing as planned.'

factual_claims.claim: Financing activities remained a focal point, with the group advancing its deleveraging trajectory through targeted privatisation sales and liability management exercises that successfully extended debt maturities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Funding section: 'Heimstaden’s subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59,500 million (41,900) including both refinancings and new financings... As part of a series of liability management exercises in January 2025, Heimstaden issued SEK 750 million senior unsecured floating rate notes and EUR 430 million senior unsecured fixed rate notes and tendered the previously existing SEK and EUR maturities for 2025 and 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: Net loan-to-value decreased to 52.2% from 56.4% a year earlier, while the interest coverage ratio improved to 2.0 times.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures table: 'Net LTV, % 52.2 56.4' and 'ICR 2.0 1.9'. Also confirmed in Funding section: 'Further deleveraging was achieved through the deployment of cash proceeds from the privatisation programme to reduce outstanding debt.'

factual_claims.claim: Total interest-bearing liabilities stood at SEK 175,227 million, with an average interest rate of 3.4% and substantial unutilised credit facilities of SEK 23,449 million providing liquidity headroom.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 6.4: 'Total interest-bearing liabilities 175,227 million' and 'Unutilised credit facilities of SEK 23,449 million'. Average interest rate of 3.4% stated in Funding section.

factual_claims.claim: The group completed approximately SEK 59,500 million in refinancing and new funding transactions, including green bond issuances and bank financing, maintaining access to favourable capital market terms despite shifting macroeconomic conditions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Liability Management section: 'For the year, Heimstaden’s subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59,500 million (41,900) including both refinancings and new financings, across both unsecured capital markets and a combination of secured and unsecured bank financing... In January 2025, Fitch ratings affirmed the ‘B-‘ and revised the Outlook to Negative for Heimstaden... For subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, financing markets remained strong, with SEK 44,900 million of asset-backed financing across 24 transactions and SEK 14,600 million of capital markets issuance across seven transactions (six being green).'

factual_claims.claim: During the year, the group also recognised a goodwill impairment loss of SEK 3,707 million, primarily linked to adjusted cash flow projections and increased discount rates associated with specific operating segments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: 'Goodwill impairment -3,707 -'. Note 3.2: 'As a result of the impairment test performed, management identified goodwill impairment of SEK 3,707 million (0) for these CGU’s at the balance sheet date. The WACC applied in the impairment test increased 110-150 bps for Akelius CGUs compared to the previous year. The primary driver of the increase in WACC was a rise in levered betas...'

factual_claims.claim: Business developments were marked by continued progress on sustainability commitments and strategic investor relations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sustainability Report section and MD&A: 'Sustainability Remains Integrated'... 'Heimstaden’s subsidiary, Heimstaden Bostad, for the third consecutive year, received Sustainalytics’ highest possible ESG risk rating, “Negligible Risk,” and continues to be ranked in the Sustainalytics 2025 “ESG Global 50 Top-Rated Companies List”.' Also mentions 'continued advancement towards Science Based Targets' and 'strategic alignment' with investors.

factual_claims.claim: The subsidiary received Sustainalytics Negligible ESG risk for the third consecutive year, while energy intensity improved by 10% on a weather-corrected basis and greenhouse gas emissions fell 14.2% against the 2020 baseline.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sustainability Highlights: 'Sustainability capex from the previous years continued to pay off, driving a 5% reduction in energy intensity and a 10% reduction on a weather corrected basis, exceeding the 2% target... Continued advancement towards Science Based Targets, achieving a 14.2% reduction compared with the 2020 baseline... Tenant energy consumption accounts for more than 86% of total emissions.' Also states 'Heimstaden Bostad... received Sustainalytics’ highest possible ESG risk rating, “Negligible Risk,” and continues to be ranked in the Sustainalytics 2025 “ESG Global 50 Top-Rated Companies List”.'

factual_claims.claim: Privatisation sales accounted for SEK 10,664 million in the period, delivering 2,466 residential units at a 28.9% premium to book value.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Realised Gains/Losses from Divestment of Properties section: 'Privatisation sales of SEK 10,664 million; 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value.' Also confirmed in Q4 Highlights: 'Privatisation sales of SEK 10,664 million; 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value.'

factual_claims.claim: In legal matters, an arbitral tribunal ruled in favour of the company in the dispute initiated by shareholder Alecta, confirming no breach of the shareholders agreement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Q4 Highlights: 'In December 2025, an award in favour of Heimstaden was received in the arbitration case initiated by Alecta against Heimstaden confirming that there was no breach in the Shareholders Agreement of Heimstaden Bostad.'

factual_claims.claim: Overall, 2025 demonstrated consistent execution of the group’s evergreen investment philosophy, with solid top-line resilience, enhanced profitability, and a strengthened balance sheet positioning the company for sustained long-term value creation.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A Conclusion: '2025 will be remembered as a year further margin growth, disciplined execution, and continued positive development of fundamentals in our business... Over the following pages, our performance in 2025 is set out in detail, outlining our results, initiatives, and key figures... In this report, the management commentary has been restructured to provide greater transparency on operational performance while highlighting continued progress on our strengthening the balance sheet...'
